changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Linked the Step1X texture stage to both geometry producers.
changes.details: Operator guidance names both exact upstream recipes, the same-reference-image requirement, and the existing 240 MiB mesh input limit.

changes.summary: Required valid UVs, material, and an embedded base-color image on bounded triangle geometry before atomic GLB publication.
Pinned exact CUDA 13 CPython 3.12 ARM64 wheels for CuPy and fastrlock, closing the texture pipeline import dependency.
Added build-time geometry and texture imports and made optional pymeshlab imports annotation-safe and lazy.
Declared exact image-plus-mesh input slots and a single-GLB output slot with bounded bytes.
Made the texture Candidate installable with a bounded signed image-plus-GLB entrypoint while retaining physical Spark qualification as pending.
Pinned official Step1X source, SM121-native nvdiffrast and PyTorch3D builds, SDXL base, and the fixed SDXL VAE as immutable authorities.
Removed hidden SDXL, VAE, and BiRefNet runtime downloads; the adapter now resolves every model from an explicit read-only artifact mount.
Marked the texture binding non-executable pending Step1X source, native dependencies, and a GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated image and GLB input contract.
Replaced the broken model-card license URL with the exact upstream Apache-2.0 license.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Step1X-3D texture pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
